scope: Original generated development illustrations for the Nativity revision. Not Ori assets, not recovered historical photographs or original game assets. Original generated PNG pixels are preserved byte-for-byte; only engine UV/layout/import settings may adapt presentation.

files.brief: Restrained overhead open physical Bible with dark oxblood leather, fine empty cream pages, sewn center and red ribbon; no fantasy ornament or baked text. Clear engine-overlay writing areas at left9.5–46%, right52.6–89.5%, y10–80.5%. The modern reading interface is not an archaeological claim about a first-century book.

2x2 interpretive biblical illustration atlas: top-left Mary in Nazareth at the annunciation with no infant; top-right Mary greeting elderly Elizabeth with no babies; bottom-left Joseph asleep in humble workshop; bottom-right visible Magi visitors with Mary and a young child inside a house, not the same-night shepherd/manger scene. No baked text or UI.
files.pixelEdits: none; byte-exact copies; runtime samples four preserved quadrants
limits: Interpretive illustrations, not verified historical photographs or evidence for architectural details, people count, physical appearance, exact visit timing or sleeping arrangement.
Some upper-panel faces sit above the center band; UI aspect cropping should prefer the upper content or show the complete quadrant. No pixel crop has been baked into this file.
